_swapComment: MPGRSwapExecutor (contracts/swap) Base Mainnet gate: CLOSED. deploy-swap-executor-base-mainnet.yml, script/DeployMPGRSwapExecutorBaseMainnet.s.sol and scripts/swap-deploy/preflight.sh all fail closed while swapExecutorDeployEnabled != true.
